name: NorthRidge Center
summary: NorthRidge Center is a regional shopping mall located in Mesquite, Texas, serving the eastern Dallas metropolitan area with a diverse mix of retail and service tenants. The center operates daily from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM and maintains a strong community presence with a 4.4-star customer rating.
demographics: NorthRidge Center serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in the Mesquite area, with a strong representation of families and working-class households. The trade area draws primarily from eastern Dallas County suburbs, attracting shoppers seeking value-oriented retail options and everyday necessities. The center appeals to budget-conscious consumers across various age groups, with a significant Hispanic and African American customer base reflective of Mesquite's multicultural population. Shopping patterns indicate frequent visits for essential goods, services, and entertainment options that cater to family-oriented activities.
description: NorthRidge Center stands as a prominent shopping destination in Mesquite, Texas, serving the eastern Dallas metropolitan area since its establishment. Located at 1805 North Galloway Avenue, this regional mall has been a cornerstone of the community, providing residents with convenient access to retail, dining, and entertainment options. The center features a diverse mix of tenants catering to the everyday needs of local families and shoppers seeking value and variety. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily, NorthRidge Center offers extended shopping convenience for working families and weekend visitors alike. The mall maintains a solid reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.4-star rating from over 220 customer reviews, demonstrating its continued relevance as a gathering place for Mesquite residents and surrounding neighborhoods.
